Definition: from G1722 and G5156; terrified:--X quake, X trembled.
BiblicalUsage: Terrified — trembling with fear. Moses trembled at the burning bush and durst not behold in Acts 7:32, and at Sinai he said, I exceedingly fear and quake, in Hebrews 12:21. The Philippian jailer came trembling and fell down before Paul and Silas in Acts 16:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe trembling is the honest response to glory — Moses at the bush, Moses at the mountain, a jailer in the dark. I hold that the fear that falls down before God is the beginning of the freedom that stands up in Him.
RelatedEvents: The Burning Bush; Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
